0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-5, 2-2 at home, on a one-game losing streak) are 4th in the Atlantic and 6th in the East, 3.5 games behind the division lead, while the Celtics (9-2, 5-0 on the road... ) sit first in both the Atlantic and the East, have won four straight, and are 9-1 over their last ten. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness), and Boston is without Paul George (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Raptors lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 115-101 loss in Boston on April 5, 2026.
